dividend.title: Dividend
dividend.explanation: The dividend is the number being divided. The divisor is the number you divide by.
dividend.guidance: Put the dividend inside the bus stop and the divisor outside on the left.

remainder.title: remainder
remainder.explanation: A remainder is the amount left after making as many whole groups as possible. It must be smaller than the divisor.
remainder.guidance: Carry it to the next place value before dividing again.
examples: 8 tens ÷ 3 gives 2 tens with 2 tens left. With the next 4 units, that becomes 24 units.

decimal-extension.title: decimal point and zeros
decimal-extension.explanation: Adding zeros after a decimal point does not change the number.
decimal-extension.guidance: Continue dividing into tenths, hundredths and so on; align the answer decimal point with the dividend.
examples: 7 ÷ 2: write 7.0. The remaining 1 unit becomes 10 tenths, so the answer is 3.5.

place-value-zeros.title: place-value zeros
place-value-zeros.explanation: A zero in the answer holds a place when the divisor fits zero whole times.
place-value-zeros.guidance: Write the zero before moving to the next digit.
examples: 408 ÷ 4 = 102. The zero tens must stay in the answer.
